$comment: What a good review of each recorded PR must include. Grow this from QA notes: when Alden misses something that mattered, add it here so the next prompt change is measured against it. mustFlag passes when a 'needs your eyes' item or model finding points at the path (and line, if given).

mustFlag.why: fetchCatalog's return type changes from Promise<MetricInfo[]> to Promise<Catalog>; callers outside the diff may break.

maxSlotsOnGlob.why: Ten workflow files make the same runner bump; one grouped finding is enough.
